summary: Master payroll taxation with our comprehensive training course. Gain the knowledge needed for compliance and effective management in your organization.
lede: Payroll taxation management covers calculating employee withholdings, valuing taxable benefits and reconciling statutory contributions. For payroll, HR and finance professionals, it provides a structured approach to accurate payroll tax processing and filing. Learners practise progressive withholding calculations, benefits-in-kind assessment and year-end reconciliation, alongside compliance monitoring and audit preparation.
audienceIntro: This course is essential for professionals responsible for the financial integrity and regulatory standing of the payroll function.
modules: Payroll Taxation Foundations and Global Standards
prerequisites: Participants should have a foundational understanding of payroll processing and basic accounting principles. Familiarity with ERP systems (such as SAP®, Oracle®, or Workday®) and Microsoft Excel for data analysis is highly recommended. No prior advanced tax law knowledge is required, as the course covers foundational concepts before moving to intermediate application.
